sup:70530.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
Thank you for explaining the cost pressures behind your proposal; we understand that larger price steps require pricing committee approval and that management has frozen price cuts. Our forecast for this part is rising, and we can offer a long contract term to support your planning, while the binding volume is set out below. Could you review the terms we propose after the cited data, particularly the points that can move under your approval process?

We confirm a binding volume of 4580 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 412.74 (po:4500014465-10, po:4500014417-10, po:4500014351-10).
Our forecast for this part is up 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 419.78 per unit, payment 90 days net, 36 months, 4580 units a year.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We acknowledge your verified forecast and the proposed 36-month contract term, which supports our long-term planning. While a 90-day payment term exceeds our standard parameters, we can agree to an extension to 60 days net. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION.

Our revised Angebot provides a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net: €430.68 per unit, for a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
